parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State how the solubilities of the hydroxides of the Group 2 elements vary down the group.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Explain the factors that are responsible for this variation.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: The solubility of $\text{Sr(OH)}_2$ is $3.37 \times 10^{-2}\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ at $0\,^{\circ}\text{C}$.
parts.text: Write an expression for the solubility product of $\text{Sr(OH)}_2$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the value of $K_{\text{sp}}$ at $0\,^{\circ}\text{C}$. Include units in your answer.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: Metal peroxides contain the $^{-}\text{O}-\text{O}^{-}$ ion. The peroxides of the Group 2 elements, $\text{MO}_2$, decompose on heating to produce a single gas and the solid oxide, $\text{MO}$, only.
parts.text: Write an equation for the thermal decomposition of strontium peroxide, $\text{SrO}_2$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest how the temperature at which thermal decomposition of $\text{MO}_2$ occurs varies down Group 2. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem: The ethanedioates of the Group 2 elements, $\text{MC}_2\text{O}_4$, decompose on heating to produce a mixture of two different gases and the solid oxide, $\text{MO}$, only.
parts.text:
Complete the equation for the thermal decomposition of barium ethanedioate.
$$\text{BaC}_2\text{O}_4 \rightarrow \ldots\ldots + \ldots\ldots + \ldots\ldots$$

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Describe **two** observations you would make during the reaction when ethanedioic acid, $\text{H}_2\text{C}_2\text{O}_4$, is warmed with acidified manganate(VII) ions.
